name: smwsprites-runman
title: RunMan
description:
This sprite acts like RunMan.
More information in the .asm file itself.

Included is levelASM that destroys the goal tape if the time limit reaches 0. It is intended for use with a patch that disables the time reaching 0 from killing you in a specific level. (Removed because it was simply not working at all)
